name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
briefDescription: PM-DAKSH gives free skill training to SC, OBC, EWS, DNT and Safai Mitra beneficiaries (aged 18–45), covering short-term, long-term and upskilling programmes with a daily stipend and placement support.
descriptionMd:
Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH), launched in 2020–21 by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, is a skill-development scheme for socially and economically marginalised groups. It provides **free, industry-relevant skill training** across trades ranging from beauty, tailoring and construction to IT and automotive repair — with placement support on completion.

The scheme is implemented through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) of National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC), National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC) and National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC).
benefitsMd:
All training is **100% government-funded** — no fees charged to the trainee.

| Programme Type | Duration | Stipend |
|---------------|----------|---------|
| **Short-term training** (new skills) | 31–180 days | ₹1,000–₹1,500/month |
| **Long-term training** (NSQF Level 5+) | >6 months | ₹1,500/month |
| **Re-skilling / Upskilling** | 32–80 hours | ₹3,000 lump sum |
| **Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP)** | ≥80 hours | ₹10,000 one-time grant |

Additionally:
- **Certification** on passing the final assessment (issued by the relevant Sector Skill Council).
- **Placement assistance** — partnering employers or self-employment support after training.
- Residential and non-residential batches available.
eligibilityMd:
- Indian citizen aged **18 to 45 years**.
- Must belong to one of:
  1. **Scheduled Castes (SC)**
  2. **Other Backward Classes (OBC)**
  3. **Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)**
  4. **Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT)**
  5. **Safai Mitras and Waste Pickers**
- Annual family income **up to ₹3 lakh** (for OBC, ₹1 lakh in some states; verify at application time).
- For OBC: valid **OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate** required.
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Go to the **Skill India Digital Hub** at [skillindiadigital.gov.in](https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/).
**Step 2:** Click **'Register'** (top-right corner) and choose **'Learner/Participant'**.
**Step 3:** Enter your mobile number and verify the OTP.
**Step 4:** Complete your profile — personal details, category (SC/OBC/EWS/DNT/Safai Mitra), Aadhaar, income certificate.
**Step 5:** Search for PM-DAKSH courses in your area and trade, and apply for your preferred batch.
**Step 6:** On selection, you'll receive a confirmation; attend the training at the designated centre or online (for digital skills).
